text.formatted: The swarm can't use its blindsight while Deafened.
text.plain: The swarm can't use its blindsight while Deafened.

text.formatted: The swarm has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on hearing.
text.plain: The swarm has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on hearing.

text.formatted: The swarm can occupy another creature's space and vice versa, and the swarm can move through any opening large enough for a Tiny bat. The swarm can't regain hit points or gain temporary hit points.
text.plain: The swarm can occupy another creature's space and vice versa, and the swarm can move through any opening large enough for a Tiny bat. The swarm can't regain hit points or gain temporary hit points.

text.formatted: _Melee Weapon Attack:_ +4 to hit, reach 0 ft., one creature in the swarm's space. _Hit:_ 5 (2d4) piercing damage, or 2 (1d4) piercing damage if the swarm has half of its hit points or fewer.
text.plain: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 0 ft., one creature in the swarm's space. Hit: 5 (2d4) piercing damage, or 2 (1d4) piercing damage if the swarm has half of its hit points or fewer.
